{{LOC_ROYAL_BEDCHAMBER}}

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_STAFF}}

LIGHTING REFERENCES

CAMERA AND IDENTITY

Create exactly 20 seconds of horizontal 16:9 live-action cinema. Use the timed hard cuts below, real-time action, no slow motion. Preserve referenced identities, costumes and rigid handmade masks; eye openings and mask edges never deform. All humans wear their referenced masks. Zahhak keeps his established support hand, weaker-leg side and exact reference snake count: natural single-headed black snakes remain independently alive in every visible shot. Panic accelerates his uneven attempts, never cures his limp. Camera is a frightened witness beside Zahhak: close handheld, body-driven recoil, obstructed frames, searching pans and short focus losses followed by recovery of the essential action. Each cut changes physical viewpoint, height or lens; no digital crop pretending to be a new shot. Other people are seen from his viewing position or the explicitly described reverse. No smooth gimbal, unmotivated orbit, zoom, or static portrait. Only a shot explicitly marked LOCKED may stop moving. World directions stay fixed; screen positions belong to each stated angle. Masks stay attached when heads turn; a full backward look requires a torso pivot.

FIXED SPACE

One immense PRIVATE ROYAL BEDCHAMBER, not a throne hall. NORTH: a raised platform with a luxurious burgundy Persian-textile BED, reached by one broad step. A level main floor runs 12 meters SOUTH from that platform to the NORTH stairs of a roughly six-meter-square sunken seating area. Exactly THREE broad shallow steps descend SOUTH into this lower square. The lower floor has thick carpets and perimeter cushions with clear standing/walking space; a narrow exposed stone strip borders the central carpet. Massive columns, bronze objects and cabinets surround the MAIN floor. EAST/WEST entrances near the NORTH bed zone connect to dark corridors. All real companions may move on the main floor and rim, never down onto ANY recess step or lower floor. Only Zahhak and named dream/prophecy bodies occupy the lower square. No extra people.

PLAN 06 | LIGHT AND EXPOSURE

DEEP NIGHT. Blackness is the dominant image, not a blue-lit room. The ONLY source is one fixed vertical cold silver-blue shaft through a small ceiling opening directly above the CENTER OF THE SUNKEN SQUARE. It lands on one isolated circular patch of the LOWER floor. Its edge is sharply contained; faint airborne dust describes the shaft only inside it. Surrounding air remains black and clear, without room-filling haze. The beam never follows a person or changes position with the camera.

The bedroom keeps its full architecture and three levels, but most walls, columns, cabinets, bronze objects, bed textiles, upper floor and doorways disappear completely. All lamps stay unlit. No daylight, window light, corridor spill, face key, fill, additional rim light or second spotlight. The lit carpet is a receiving surface, never an emissive floor: dark textiles absorb light, allowing only extremely weak localized bounce outside the patch. Do not brighten the set merely to explain the geography.

At close range, reveal a fragment at a time: one visible eye through a rigid mask opening, a narrow mask plane, a knuckle, a cloth fold or one moving snake glint. Never evenly expose the whole face or body. A turn can take that fragment back into black. Highlights belong to fixed world-space light, not the lens; no permanent eye catchlight, luminous eyes or light that tracks a face. Keep masks and skin unchanged. Emotional action stays legible through these fragments, movement and breath.

Expose for the lit patch without clipping it; lock exposure and black level through every cut and focus change. Close-ups and reverse angles receive no compensating light. Preserve large areas of true black without shadow recovery or a uniform blue wash; only sparse highlights carry restrained silver-blue color. Dream and prophecy figures never reveal identifying facial planes, mask details or eyes, including in low angles. Their silhouettes come from the existing shaft or lit floor behind them, never a new backlight. No aura, energy effects or glowing outlines.

Lighting references control darkness, light isolation and fragmentary visibility only. Do not import their people, faces, clothing, sports spaces, corridors or objects. Character and location references control identity and construction, not their photographed brightness. The written lighting overrides any brighter reference. Each shot's LIGHTING instruction defines the visible fragment; everything else may remain black. Do not replace every shot with total black: the specified action-bearing detail must remain faintly readable.

All seven REAL companions remain physically present after their entrance, even when framing and darkness hide them: Arnavaz, Guards A/B, Priests P1/P2/P3 and Zirak. Their exact marks are specified below. No identity swaps, no duplication. Prophecy agents, when listed, use the guard costume design but have separate roles from the real rim guards. The staged dream/prophecy imagery belongs to this same lower space, not a new location. In the prophecy, the real group directs its gaze toward the central tableau as instructed. START BLOCK

START STATE AND BLOCKING

Zahhak curled NORTH of lower pool center, staff on floor within reach at support side. Arnavaz NE rim; P1 N east of stairs; Guard A N west; P2 W; P3 SW; Zirak behind P2; Guard B SE. All seven watch from ABOVE, frightened. No dream character is present. Moon-pool center is otherwise empty.

SHOT 06-01 | 00–03s | GET UP

24mm from WEST at Zahhak's floor height. He peels one arm from his face, searches for the staff and catches it after one missed reach. Camera crawls forward with his hand, shifts focus from carpet fibers to fingers and rises too late when he forces his torso up. His knees and staff take his weight.

LIGHTING: A tiny floor reflection finds carpet fibers, then reaching fingers and a partial shoulder. Most of his body remains black. The rising camera receives no extra light as it searches for his face.

SHOT 06-02 | 03–06s | AN OPEN HAND

28mm at his WEST shoulder as he faces NORTH toward P1 above the stairs. He lunges one limping step toward the rim and raises an open shaking palm. Camera pushes with his chest; frame clips his mask. His posture is pleading, throat tight and shoulders bent, not issuing a calm command.

LIGHTING: The open hand takes weak bounce while the raised face is mostly hidden. A brief eye trace may appear and vanish with his lunge. P1 above remains a dark body, not a separate lit subject.

SHOT 06-03 | 06–09s | P1 RETREATS

35mm over Zahhak's SOUTH shoulder looking NORTH/up. P1 starts just east of stairs and retreats toward NORTHWEST behind Guard A, who shifts aside on the main floor. The outstretched hand remains foreground. Pan after P1 as the reply fails to come; Arnavaz stays at northeast edge, worried.

LIGHTING: P1's retreat removes his small mask fragment from the bounce into black; Guard A is an overlapping shadow. Zahhak's dim hand anchors the view. No upper-floor fill reveals their full retreating bodies.

SHOT 06-04 | 09–12s | THE NEXT PERSON MOVES AWAY

24mm from NORTH of Zahhak, close to his shoulder as he turns WEST and hurries along the lower rim toward P2. The camera turns with his torso, then pushes toward P2 above. P2 retreats half a step WEST, shoulders crowding P3 southwest. The distance stays ordinary and physical; camera and subject keep trying to close it.

LIGHTING: Keep the western rim nearly black. Only the approaching hand and one low sleeve edge separate as the distance changes. P2 and P3 remain overlapping dark shapes, not uniformly readable figures.

PLAN 06 | TIMED SHOTS AND HANDOFF

SHOT 06-05 | 12–15s | ZIRAK INSIDE THE PACK

50mm from just beside Zahhak's eye line looking WEST/up through the narrow gap between P2 and P3. Zirak is BEHIND them, half his mask hidden by shoulders. He pushes one shoulder forward and lifts a hand between their sleeves, then retreats into their shadow when Zahhak jerks nearer. No empty space around him; no heroic portrait.

LIGHTING: Zirak's hand and a tiny mask fragment appear only through the gap, then disappear behind dark shoulders. There is no personal spotlight, outlining light or exposed face to mark his attempted advance.

SHOT 06-06 | 15–18s | LOOK AT ME

28mm intimate lateral handheld beside Zahhak facing WEST/up. He tries to catch P2's gaze, lifting his open palm higher, breathing in broken bursts. Pan from his near eye to P2's downturned face and back, staying below the rim. P2 looks away and P3 folds his hands protectively; fear differs between them.

LIGHTING: The pan searches between one faint eye fragment and a priest's mostly black turned mask. Empty intervals remain genuinely dark. Do not lift exposure to keep both faces readable during the turn.

SHOT 06-07 | 18–20s | REACHING THE ROBE

50mm tight from SOUTH of Zahhak at the WEST lip. His hand finally touches P2's hanging outer robe; his staff remains loaded. Camera drives into the contact and briefly loses focus in dark cloth. P2 stiffens above him. End at first touch, before a full grip.

LIGHTING: A narrow finger highlight and one tension fold make the first contact legible. The dark cloth can swallow focus and most of the image. No new light reveals P2's torso or the upper floor.

END STATE AND EDIT

Zahhak upright but bent at WEST lower rim, facing WEST/up at P2; free fingertips on P2's hanging robe, staff planted. P2/P3 and Zirak behind P2 form a tight WEST/SOUTHWEST cluster; P1 has retreated NW near Guard A. Arnavaz NE, Guard B SE. All seven remain on main-floor rim, nobody below.

SOUND

Ragged breathing becomes a pleading wordless exhalation; staff scrapes, rushed shuffling, robes tightening and shoes retreating above. Silence from the priests is active refusal, not quiet room ambience. No spoken questions generated.

Generate diegetic effects and nonverbal breathing only. The waking scream is permitted where specified. NO INTELLIGIBLE DIALOGUE. NO GENERATED NARRATION. NO MUSIC. Supplied poetry/voice is added separately in editing; do not invent words.
